rav-mattana.name: Rav Mattana
rav-mattana.bio: Babylonian Amora, a student of Shmuel whose teachings he transmits.
rav-mattana.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard touched with grey and a plain dark mantle, speaking with a steady, explanatory look as if citing a verse; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps in Nehardea.

rabbi-shmuel-bar-nachmani.name: Rabbi Shmuel bar Naḥmani
rabbi-shmuel-bar-nachmani.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel and a master of aggada, who transmits many teachings of his teacher Rabbi Yonatan.
rabbi-shmuel-bar-nachmani.prompt: A warm, eloquent elder in his 60s with a long grey beard and a cream wool mantle, one hand open as if telling a parable; background of Galilean limestone arches and olive trees.

chizkiyya.name: Ḥizkiyya
chizkiyya.era: Amora · Land of Israel, early 3rd century
chizkiyya.bio: Son of Rabbi Ḥiyya and a teacher of Rabbi Yoḥanan, among the first Amoraim of the Land of Israel.
chizkiyya.prompt: A scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard and a plain linen mantle, reading closely from a scroll of Chronicles as if rereading one word; background of a Tiberias study hall with the Sea of Galilee softly beyond.

balvatei.name: Balvatei
balvatei.bio: A sage cited once in the Talmud, transmitting a teaching of Rabbi Yoḥanan; Rashi explains the word as a sage’s name.
balvatei.prompt: A modest scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a simple grey mantle, repeating a teaching with a careful expression; background of soft limestone arches in Tiberias.

chananya-ben-achi-rabbi-yehoshua.name: Ḥananya, son of Rabbi Yehoshua’s brother
chananya-ben-achi-rabbi-yehoshua.bio: Tanna, a nephew of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Ḥananya.
chananya-ben-achi-rabbi-yehoshua.prompt: A confident scholar in his 40s with a dark beard and a plain wool mantle, gesturing toward a scroll of Exodus; background of a study hall at Yavne with simple stone benches.

rabbi-yochanan-ben-gudgeda.name: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Gudgeda
rabbi-yochanan-ben-gudgeda.bio: A Levite gatekeeper of the Second Temple, remembered for eating even ordinary food in the purity of consecrated food (Ḥagiga 2:7).
rabbi-yochanan-ben-gudgeda.prompt: An elderly Levite in his 70s with a long white beard and a simple white linen garment, standing beside a great bronze-clad Temple gate, one hand raised gently as if sending a younger man back; background of Jerusalem limestone courtyards.

rami-brei-derav-yeiva.name: Rami, son of Rav Yeiva
rami-brei-derav-yeiva.bio: Babylonian Amora, son of Rav Yeiva.
rami-brei-derav-yeiva.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a plain dark headwrap, reasoning through a calendar question with a raised finger; background of mudbrick academy walls and palm trees.

rav-avya.name: Rav Avya
rav-avya.bio: Babylonian Amora of the fourth century.
rav-avya.prompt: A sharp-eyed Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a greying beard and a plain wool mantle, leaning forward as if raising a practical objection; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.
